transcript.text: Been in the print industry for nearly 30 years.
That's a bit of a journey.

We were looking at an online ecom site for the business about five years ago and we tried various platforms, but what we always found was the amount of conditional logic, the amount of variations in product just let us down various rabbit holes in it.
We can never find a solution that that get a client.
You know the exact best UI to get that that price and product list from the site.
We actually tried using the Shopify site, but the problem we had was in order to do the the complicated calculations and and issues with delivery and integrations with various bird patent platforms.
We had to use numerous apps to do that.

And by the time we got to a solution about 18 months later, what we found was that the page load times 10/10/13 seconds, which I guess in any situation that is an absolutely horrendous experience for any customer that I came across on Print Shop.
And after spending some time reviewing some of the details of the product offering, I thought, wow, this is exactly what we're looking for here.

But working together in partnership where we're able to formulate solution, they gave us what we needed in terms of job management and gave our customers a solution to get their pricing pretty much straight away.
I guess the fact that I had already used the software one year prior to COVID starting, we had that that year of getting to use the software and a lot of clients were using it also.

And because the software was able to give our clients that immediate pricing for products, probably 65% of a client utilize the website to buy product from us as opposed to telephone contacts, the, the emails, you know, back and forward in order to get the product solution that they required.
Even after COVID, I guess the biggest change for us is the amount of the amount of hands off time that we have to manage clients.
But generally the support for you guys has been first class.
I can honestly say there's been not one question that I've asked you guys that has been answered.

It may well be that it's not been an off the shelf, you know, solution that you've had to go away and do a bit of revision on what I need, but you've always came back to me with, with a with a solution.
